about_the_game:
Second Chance

Tired of the monotony and burden of modern life? Longing for a new opportunity, a fresh start in a different place? Your wish has been heard. A mysterious system answers your call, tearing you from your gray reality and plunging you into a vibrant world, with places both calm and others filled with danger.

Upon opening your eyes, you find yourself in an unknown realm, wearing strange attire, surrounded by dense forests, imposing mountains, and whispering ruins. An enigmatic skill system awakens within you, offering powers and knowledge that grow with each challenge you overcome. But this world doesn't forgive the weak: to survive, you'll need to hunt, explore, and unravel the secrets that brought you here.


Features


Explore a Living, Dynamic World: Immerse yourself in stunning landscapes, from enchanted forests and villages to treacherous caves. Every corner of this world hides secrets, allies, or threats. Play solo or team up with friends to brave this epic adventure together.

Survive and Thrive: Survival is the foundation of your rebirth. Hunt wild beasts, gather resources, and master the art of crafting to build your base, forge legendary weapons, and create unique gear that reflects your playstyle.

Challenge Epic Bosses and Ferocious Predators: Face colossal creatures and cunning predators that will test your courage and strategy. Each victory strengthens your abilities, unlocks new powers, and enhances your arsenal, bringing you closer to mastering this world.

Unravel the Mystery of Your Destiny: Why were you brought here? Who or what controls the system that guides your steps? Explore ancient ruins, interact with enigmatic characters, and uncover the truth behind it.


Why Play Isekai Mystic World?


With a deep progression system, thrilling combat, and a world that reacts to your actions, Isekai Mystic World offers a survival RPG experience that combines exploration, crafting, and immersive storytelling. Whether you're a lone wolf or a team leader, this is your moment to rewrite your story.

Embark now on this world and turn the unknown into your greatest adventure!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64 bits or higher
  • Processor: intel i5 8400 or AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX-1060 / AMD Radeon RX 590
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 64 bits or higher
  • Processor: Intel core i5-10600 or AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2070, 6GB or AMD Radeon RX 5700 XT, 8GB
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space

short_description: Your wish has come true: welcome to Isekai Mystic World! Explore a vibrant world, hunt, fish, farm, and build your home. Forge epic weapons, face dangers, and uncover secrets, alone or with friends, in this action-survival adventure!
supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Simplified Chinese, Korean, Spanish - Latin America, Japanese, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian
